tickets.title: Every lift and ring outcome is told in sources and counted in the monitor (**amendment 6, 2026-10-19**)

authority.locator: P61 · section 2 of amendment 6; ANALYSIS.md §1 and §5 F1
authority.requirement: see amendment 6 section 2, ticket P61 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: An operator reading a decision's sources sees why a learned lift or a fatigue term was or was not applied, per slot and with the milliseconds, and the monitor counts each outcome per tenant, instead of a silent null.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a decision answered with the lift served names sources.lift[slot].outcome 'served' with its milliseconds; with the witness delayed past its budget, 'late' with ms at or above the budget; with a copy the object never published, 'unrecognized'; with an incompatible copy, 'incompatible'; with no copy, 'none'; with an unhealthy object, 'unhealthy'; with a superseded copy, 'superseded'; with a failed call, 'failed'.
criteria.proof: The P61 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P61.LO1 in src/units/P61 and they pass.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, sources.ring.outcome names 'read' when the ring answered within its budget, 'late' when it did not, 'failed' on an error and 'skipped' when no slot has a fatigue dial, each with milliseconds.
criteria.proof: The P61 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P61.LO2 in src/units/P61 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The monitor counts each lift and ring outcome per tenant and the counts equal what the decisions reported.
criteria.proof: The P61 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P61.LO3 in src/units/P61 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: the ledger record, the replay equality and the shopper's decisions[] members are byte for byte as today; P07 C4's term-for-term comparison, P42 PW3, P49 and P50 units unchanged; the witness's boolean shape kept for its callers.
criteria.proof: The P61 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P61.LO4 in src/units/P61 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

existingEvidence.description: Both mechanisms traced and reproduced locally (E0–E5); the hosted laps and KV lags from lanes L1, L3, L7.

remainingWork: Internal witness reason; sources.lift and sources.ring members; monitor counters per tenant.
The learning-reads count runs after the answer and outside the shopper's serializer (tenant-level state), so the shopper's next request never waits on it (R-P115).

decisions.authorityRef: R-P110 (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md, 2026-10-19) under the owner's standing rule R-P78
decisions.effect: Outcomes are named on the answer's sources, never on the record, so every record lock stays.

tickets.title: The lift witness tolerates the edge: named, configurable budgets with an edge-sized default, a light witness door, and a same-generation superseded copy served with asOf (**amendment 6, 2026-10-19**)

authority.locator: P62 · section 2 of amendment 6; ANALYSIS.md §4 and §5 F2, F3
authority.requirement: see amendment 6 section 2, ticket P62 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A published and confirmed learned lift is served to the shopper on the deployed workers, not withheld by a budget sized for an in-process object or by a copy a routine republication superseded seconds earlier.

criteria.observable: The lift witness budget and the ring read budget are exported named constants with a validated, bounded environment override; the code defaults are derived in the specification from the engine's measured object cost and a per-call round trip and are above the edge's observed witness laps; W38 B7's late-answer lock holds as 'budget plus margin' (R10).
criteria.proof: The P62 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P62.LW1 in src/units/P62 and they pass.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, the statistics object answers a witness door from a verdict cached at commit or publish without reading or digesting its whole state (a spy proves no storage.get('learn') and no whole-state digest on the door), and the decision path uses it; the health door is unchanged for operators.
criteria.proof: The P62 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P62.LW2 in src/units/P62 and they pass.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, after V1 is published and decided and the object republishes V2, a decision holding the V1 copy within the isolate cache, and one served from a KV copy still answering V1, are both served with explain.lift.asOf.version V1 and latest V2; a copy outside the bounded window, a forged digest, a different witness (configuration, fence or projection), an unhealthy object, and a copy after an explicit reset or generation transition are not served.
criteria.proof: The P62 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P62.LW3 in src/units/P62 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: compatible(), the refusal of an unpublished digest, the generation and fence binding, state healthy, the P42 stale and P49 republished members, no lift read on the default arm, the page-scoped witness, the ring's bound, the publish order; P42, P49, P50, P55, W26 R2, W23 H1 units unchanged; records without asOf byte for byte as today.
criteria.proof: The P62 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P62.LW4 in src/units/P62 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

existingEvidence.description: Both mechanisms traced and reproduced locally (E0–E5); the hosted laps and KV lags from lanes L1, L3, L7.

remainingWork: Constants and env override; the W38 B7 R10 (budget plus margin).
The witness door on LearnStats with a cached verdict; the decision path's witness uses it.
The recent-publication window on the object; the same-generation acceptance; explain.lift.asOf only when not latest.
The ring call is aborted at its budget so the owner never waits past it (the lock's property made true, R-P112); the asOf member carried through replay.ts.

decisions.authorityRef: R-P110 (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md, 2026-10-19) under the owner's standing rule R-P78
decisions.effect: The code default is raised and sized for the edge; W38 B7 keeps its property with the literal replaced (R-P110 decision 1).

decisions.authorityRef: R-P110 (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md, 2026-10-19) under the owner's standing rule R-P78
decisions.effect: A superseded copy of the same generation is served within a bounded window, marked asOf (R-P110 decision 2).

tickets.title: The statistics object does not republish an unchanged state (**amendment 6, 2026-10-19**)

authority.locator: P63 · section 2 of amendment 6; ANALYSIS.md §5 F2b, E5
authority.requirement: see amendment 6 section 2, ticket P63 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: Routine alarms stop moving the published version when nothing changed, so copies are superseded only by real evidence, while a stale or republished marker is still cleared by the next alarm publication as P42 PW2 promises.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, two alarms with no new evidence between them leave the published version unchanged (today it moves: E5).
criteria.proof: The P63 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P63.NR1 in src/units/P63 and they pass.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, an alarm after new evidence publishes a new version as today.
criteria.proof: The P63 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P63.NR2 in src/units/P63 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: with a stale or republished marker in force the next alarm publication succeeds and clears it (P42 PW2, P49 units unchanged); the publish order unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P63 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P63.NR3 in src/units/P63 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

existingEvidence.description: Both mechanisms traced and reproduced locally (E0–E5); the hosted laps and KV lags from lanes L1, L3, L7.

remainingWork: Skip the alarm publication when the state digest equals the last published digest and no marker is in force.
